systems.description: Engine systems this game explicitly turns on or off. Anything not declared keeps the engine default; unknown ids, systems the runtime requires, and systems with no implementation are rejected. Run `game systems list` for the current set.

audio.description: Sound categories and the rules between them. Undeclared means no rules, not no sound: a game can play and loop without ever naming a category. Categories exist to say what happens *between* sounds, which is the part the engine owns.

categories.description: Category name to rules. The engine does not name bgm or sfx; the taxonomy is the game's.

exclusive.description: Only one loop in this category plays at a time; starting another begins stopping the previous one.

fade_in_frames.description: Frames a loop in this category spends in the fading_in phase. The engine counts the frames; the host does the gain ramp.

fade_out_frames.description: Frames a stopped loop stays in the observation, marked fading_out, before the engine retires it.

max_concurrent.description: Reserved name, not implemented in this build. Declaring it is an error (AUDIO_RULE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED) rather than a silent no-op.

on_limit.description: Reserved name, not implemented in this build.

ducking.description: Reserved name, not implemented in this build.

priority.description: Reserved name, not implemented in this build.

exclusive_group.description: Reserved name, not implemented in this build.

ui_previews.description: Screens `game verify` must check the layout of. Without this only the opening screen is drawn, so a broken win or lose screen passes every gate.

name.description: Screen name, used in the verify step name.

input_sequence.description: Project-relative per-frame input replay that reaches this screen.

verify.description: Which gates `game verify` runs, in what order, and which of them are advisory. Undeclared means the engine's default order (types, assets, layout, tests) with every gate required. A skipped gate has to be a written decision: an empty list, an unknown id and a duplicate are all errors.

steps.description: The gates to run, in order. Each entry is either the gate id or an object naming it.

required.description: false makes the gate advisory: a failure is reported in full and named in the run's effect line, but does not fail the run.

command.description: Reserved name for a project-owned command as a gate. Not implemented in this build; declaring it is an error (VERIFY_STEP_NOT_IMPLEMENTED) rather than a step that silently never runs.
